en: initialism of без на́шей отве́тственности (bez nášej otvétstvennosti): without our responsibility

initialism of Белору́сская Наро́дная Респу́блика (Belorússkaja Naródnaja Respúblika): Belarusian People's Republic (a former country that controlled most of modern Belarus from 1918–19, and a government-in-exile to the present day)
